title: W3Schools: Group Anagrams
description: Given an array of strings `words`, group the anagrams together into sublists. Return the groups sorted by their first element.
constraints:
0 <= len(words) <= 10^4
• Time: O(N * K log K) | Space: O(N * K)
explanation: Sorted character signatures group anagrams into hash map in O(N * K log K) time.
